Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@wellnesthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — procurement delay, demo at risk

Hi Camila,

Quick note from procurement: our purchase request is with legal and finance and it looks like approval will slide past the demo window (likely 7–10 business days). We love the integration so far but the team will lose momentum if the sandbox times out.

Is there any possibility Redwood can:
- pause the trial countdown for a short window, or
- provide a small top-up of demo credits so our engineers can finish the full integration?

Attaching the current purchase request for visibility (purchase_request_wellnest.pdf). Marcus and I can share an ETA once finance comes back.

Appreciate any flexibility — we want to keep this moving.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform Integrations
Wellnest Health

Subject: Re: Quick ask — procurement delay, demo at risk

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the request. Sorry to hear finance is taking longer than expected.

We can absolutely help keep the demo live while you finish routing the PO. Two quick options that would work from our side:

1) A short 72-hour token top-up so your engineers can complete integration tests now (fast, no paperwork).
2) Pause the trial countdown for up to five calendar days while the PO clears (we usually do this for validated purchase intents).

If you can confirm the expected PO clear date (even a rough ETA) I’ll get an internal sign-off. I’ve looped in Ben (sales ops) and Karthik (team lead) to speed approval — internal note below.

Proposed: 72-hour top-up + pause the countdown if PO ETA is >72 hours.

What would you prefer? If it helps, a signed one-page amendment or a quick DocuSign can lock the extension.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
